Source check, next 15.5.28 dist/client/components/layout-router.js InnerScrollAndFocusHandler: after a client navigation Next calls domNode.focus() on the first element of the changed segment (skipping sticky and fixed ones). If the (app) layout renders the shell and each page starts with <h1 tabIndex={-1}>, focus reaches the h1 with no extra client code. But a shared layout is not re-rendered on navigation and gets no pathname, so the rail's aria-current needs either a client island (usePathname) or the shell rendered by each page (which then defeats Next's focus handling).

deviations.from: pr-smart-finances.md SF-111 Files and Do ("Server shell with MenuPanel (from ui/patterns) as the only client island"), D-137
deviations.proposal: MenuPanel's API (children: (close) => ReactNode, from SF-109) cannot be filled by a server component: Next refuses to pass a function to a client component (build error recorded in SF-111 evidence). Also a shared (app) layout never learns the current path, so it cannot set aria-current on the rail or name the screen on the menu button. Proposed: add one new client file, apps/web/src/ui/ShellNav.tsx ('use client'), to SF-111's Files. It takes only serializable props (the nav items with href, label and icon name, the account rows, the review count and its words), reads usePathname(), and renders (1) the rail nav links with aria-current and (2) MenuPanel with a render function that shows the same links and account rows and calls close() when a link is chosen. The (app) layout keeps the server Shell (brand, env tag, account area with the /api/lang form post and Sign out, <main>), wrapped in QueryProvider; pages start with <h1 tabIndex={-1}> so Next's own focus handling moves focus to it after navigation. Alternative: change MenuPanel (SF-109 file) to accept plain children and close itself on a pathname change; that touches T-WEB-9 tests and is the larger change.
